messages:
Priya: quick sync — MerchantX pilot failing at SDK init in staging. Getting 401 on handshake when requesting ephemeral creds. Pilot kickoff tomorrow, customer blocked. Anyone seen this?
Tom: paste the exact error and SDK version?
Priya: Node log: `Error: handshake failed: 401 invalid_signature`
Priya: curl we ran: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdks/init -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"env":"staging","client_id":"merchantx"}'```
Jordan: are they using the presales connector short-lived creds or a test API key?
Priya: ephemeral via our bridge connector. Followed runbook but suspect connector host header was altered by their proxy.
Devon: MerchantX sits behind a mutual TLS proxy. Proxy has rewritten Host header before HMAC signed by client reaches bridge — causes signature mismatch.
ops-bot: bridge v0.9.3 note: preserves X-Forwarded-* by default; HMAC verification uses original Host in signature. Proxy rewrite can break validation.
Tom: workaround: SDK init supports `overrideHost: "bridge.internal"` to match signed host. If they can't change proxy, set that in client config.
Priya: trying overrideHost now. Also MerchantX asked for KMS/BYOK details and SOC2 evidence for their security questionnaire. Do we have packaged artifacts?
Devon: we keep SOC2 + ISO artifacts in compliance drive; for KMS we support BYOK in Private and integrate with Cloud KMS for Dedicated. I'll pull standard language and sample contract clauses.
Jordan: note: Private deployment uses short-lived client certs instead of HMAC tokens — avoids Host-dependent signatures entirely. Useful to propose to security team.
Priya: overrideHost allowed handshake to proceed but streaming SSE fails with `ERR: unsupported_protocol` during stream init.
Jordan: what SDK version? Older SDKs had TLS ALPN mismatch for SSE endpoints. Upgrade to SDK 2.4.1+.
Priya: they were on 2.3.0. Upgrading.
Priya: upgrade fixed SSE. Outstanding: 1) provide KMS/BYOK writeup for their questionnaire, 2) pilot pricing comparison: hosted vs Dedicated reserved for 1 month.
Devon: presales discount for a 1-month reserved pilot typically 30% off list for committed capacity; I'll open a quote with Legal for exact numbers. I'll assemble KMS one-pager and sample contract text.
Priya: can we schedule an architect call tomorrow 10am PT with MerchantX infra to walk SSO, IP allowlist, callback flow for structured outputs and function-call tooling?
Tom: I can join to cover streaming behavior, fallbacks, and latency tradeoffs.
Jordan: I'll demo SDK init, ephemeral creds, and host override.
Devon: I'll bring KMS notes and compliance artifacts. Priya, please send invite and attach SOC2/KMS docs.
Priya: invite sent. Runbook link: https://redwood.com/docs/presales/runbooks/bridge-handshake
Tom: we should add a short doc for proxies that rewrite Host headers — recurring presales snag.
Priya: filing docs ticket now :memo:
Devon: :thumbsup: will update thread after the call.
ops-bot: reminder: presales checklist item #7 (upload certs) still open for MerchantX.
